pages.title: Parkour Block Maker
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description:
Parkour Block Maker combines playable parkour courses with a built-in level editor. Choose from community-made maps and try to improve on other players' high scores, or switch to creating a course of your own. The editor lets you build levels that become another challenge to tackle.

The game is centered on this cycle of playing, making, and comparing results. Explore different community layouts for a new parkour challenge, then apply your own ideas in the editor and see how your course plays.

pages.title: Steal Memerot: Zoo Tycoon
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Collect unusual animals in Steal Memerot: Zoo Tycoon and place them where they can earn money. Reinvest the income in rarer creatures and expand the zoo to make room for them.

pages.title: Kompot's Kitchen
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Flip ingredient cards and discover how they work together in Kompot's Kitchen. Build up useful cooking combinations with the chef cat, and earn enough from each round to cover the rent.

pages.title: Animal Merge Zoo Park
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Build a zoo full of wildlife in Animal Merge Zoo Park. Combine animals to expand the collection and develop your small park into a larger home for beasts and dinosaurs.

pages.title: Super Football Fever
pages.creator: XMetaGame
pages.description: Recruit stars and put together a lineup in Super Football Fever. Take the team onto a 3D pitch and work on moving the ball into scoring positions during each match.

pages.title: Plant Merge: Zombie War
pages.creator: Big Wave
pages.description: Combine plants to build a stronger garden defense in Plant Merge: Zombie War. Pick where to concentrate your upgrades and use special abilities when the undead approach in bigger groups.

pages.title: Toytopia
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Merge art supplies and turn them into repair materials in Toytopia. Use your creations to fix damaged toys, then find out what the next toy needs before you can restore it.

pages.title: Gomu Goman
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Stretch the character's arms, legs or neck in Gomu Goman to reach things around each scene. Drag the right part of the body into place and work out how to complete each unusual task.

pages.title: Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks
pages.creator: Mad Data
pages.description: Clear card layouts in Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks as you explore abandoned castles and rebuild halls. Switch to the Halloween-themed Mahjong boards for a tile challenge between solitaire levels.

pages.title: Catch Thief
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Move the police to cut off escape routes in Catch Thief. Think ahead about which way the thief could go next, and leave no opening when you push him toward a dead end.

pages.title: Agent Hunt: Spy Shooter Game
pages.creator: dotplay gmbh
pages.description: Take covert assignments in Agent Hunt: Spy Shooter Game. Use a sniper rifle to line up precise shots and think about how to approach each target without giving away your position.

pages.title: Mahjong Quest: Candyland Adventures
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Pair up tiles as you travel through a land of sweets in Mahjong Quest: Candyland Adventures. Clear the pieces blocking each board to see where the candy-themed route takes you next.

pages.title: The Hardest Puzzle Ever
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Put the pieces of a picture into their exact spots in The Hardest Puzzle Ever. Compare similar colors and details before placing each piece, then return for a new daily level.

pages.title: Jewel Miner Quest
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Match gems and complete board objectives in Jewel Miner Quest. Check how many moves or how much time you have for each event, and pick up daily bonuses along the way.

pages.title: Mine Quest Daily
pages.creator: Denda Games
pages.description: Use the numbers on revealed squares to find safe moves in Mine Quest Daily. Each clue tells you how many mines border it, so compare neighboring clues before uncovering another square.

pages.title: My Fire Station World
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Follow firefighters through emergency calls and station life in My Fire Station World. Help with rescues and fires, and see what the crew does during a day on the job.

pages.title: Heist Defender
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Work as a bank security expert in Heist Defender. Get into position to stop the robbery and deal with the intruders as they try to get past the bank's defenses.

pages.title: Easter Glamping Trip
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Dress the princesses for a spring camping trip in Easter Glamping Trip. Pick outfits for their stay in the Norwegian mountains and put together looks for the holiday away.

pages.title: Money Man 3D
pages.creator: Seryas Games
pages.description: Run as a character made of money in Money Man 3D. Dodge obstacles that can tear away your body, collect loose cash to rebuild it, and use power-ups to keep going.

pages.title: Mahjong Seasons 2 - Autumn and Winter
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Clear pairs of matching tiles in Mahjong Seasons 2 - Autumn and Winter. Look for pieces that open up new moves as you work through layouts inspired by the two seasons.

pages.title: Cooking Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Prepare dishes to order in Cooking Mania and serve customers before the rush overwhelms the kitchen. Try five restaurants of increasing difficulty and upgrade your equipment to keep up with demand.

pages.title: Mini Moto Speed Race
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Dodge obstacles and take swings at computer-controlled racers in Mini Moto Speed Race. Gather diamonds during the races and put them toward different bikes and weapons in the shop.

pages.title: Spaceship Destruction
pages.creator: Best Games
pages.description: Fight off attacking spacecraft across seven levels in Spaceship Destruction. Keep firing as the enemies close in and collect energy and bombs to help you get through tougher attacks.

pages.title: Squid Game Challenge Online
pages.creator: Flikes Games
pages.description: Take your squad into a tug-of-war in Squid Game Challenge Online. Pull the rope toward your side and keep up the pressure to beat the opposing team.

pages.title: Stickman vs Aliens
pages.creator: PandaPashaGames
pages.description: Search an alien-infested ship in Stickman vs Aliens. Fight the invaders to reach the crew and follow the story across 50 levels to discover what happened aboard.

pages.title: Jelly Battle
pages.creator: Brave Giant LTD
pages.description: Feed, clean and customize your pet in Jelly Battle. Take care of your jelly between encounters and see how it does when you bring it into a puzzle battle.

pages.title: Super Shark World
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Swim a shark past obstacles in Super Shark World. Watch the space ahead as you move through the underwater course, then spend the gold you earn on other characters.

pages.title: Students Outfits Changeover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose school outfits for Ava, Clara and Sophie in Students Outfits Changeover. Try clothes and accessories on each student and put together a look that gives her a distinct style.

pages.title: Mall Service
pages.creator: Andy Games
pages.description: Clean and organize a shopping center in Mall Service. Sign service contracts and unlock more areas to work in, then upgrade your character so you can get tasks done faster.

pages.title: Funny Daycare
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Care for baby animals in Funny Daycare. Give them baths, play with them and take on the other activities that come up while you're looking after the daycare.

pages.title: Mahjong Fruits
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Pair tiles showing the same fruit in Mahjong Fruits. Look over the layout for available matches and clear them one at a time to uncover more pieces.

pages.title: Jigsaw Collections
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Rebuild pictures from loose jigsaw pieces in Jigsaw Collections. Use edges, colors and patterns to find the correct spots, then try another image once the current puzzle is complete.

pages.title: Death Driver
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drive an armored vehicle through a zombie-filled city in Death Driver. Keep it steady over hills and smash through the undead as you try to survive the route.

pages.title: Fit and Go Shape Puzzle
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Switch your moving piece to the right shape for each opening in Fit and Go Shape Puzzle. Read the gates ahead and make quick changes as the route zigzags.

pages.title: Fist Bump
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Time your punch in Fist Bump by stopping the moving indicator in the green zone. Trade attempts with a friend and see whose timing produces the strongest bump.

pages.title: Christmas Lines
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Arrange matching holiday pieces into straight lines in Christmas Lines. Look for horizontal, vertical and diagonal opportunities as you plan your moves and try to build a high score.

pages.title: Parking Slot
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Steer an SUV into a marked spot in Parking Slot. Rotate or zoom the view to check the space around you and park quickly to earn more points and unlock achievements.

pages.title: Kick Master 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Kick your opponents out of the arena in Kick Master 3D. Pick the moment to strike and avoid getting close enough for another fighter to send you out first.

pages.title: Back To Candyland: Episode 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Remove groups of matching candies in Back To Candyland: Episode 1. Look for groups that set up useful follow-up moves and work through the level goals in the candy-themed world.

pages.title: Gems Shooter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fire gems into a rotating wheel in Gems Shooter. Connect three or more of the same color to remove them and work around the spin to reach the last few gems.

pages.title: Pixel Fps SWAT Command
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Join other players in a first-person firefight in Pixel Fps SWAT Command. Try different guns and learn how the blocky map layouts affect your aim and approach.

pages.title: Troll Face Quest: Video Memes and TV Shows: Part 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Figure out how to trigger pranks in Troll Face Quest: Video Memes and TV Shows: Part 1. Experiment with the characters and objects in each scene to see what sets up the joke.

pages.title: Preschool Games
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Pick one of four activities in Preschool Games. Young players can practice recognizing colors, shapes, animals and numbers by tapping or clicking their way through the puzzles.

pages.title: Fuzzy Maze
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Slide a red block through the corridors in Fuzzy Maze. Look for a route that lets you collect every shiny dot, and plan the order so you can reach the ones in corners.

pages.title: Adorable Puppies In Cars Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Match groups of three or more puppy-and-car blocks in Adorable Puppies In Cars Match 3. Watch the meter while you make matches and try to keep the game going for a higher score.

pages.title: Cute Dragon Recovery
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Care for an injured dragon in Cute Dragon Recovery. Treat its wounds first, then lift its spirits with an outfit and a treat once the dragon is feeling better.

pages.title: Color Pong Game
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Rotate the large balls in Color Pong Game so the small bouncing ball meets one of its own color. Follow its movement and switch quickly before it reaches either end.

pages.title: Funny Face Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Reassemble funny faces in Funny Face Jigsaw. Start with the first picture, unlock more as you finish them, and choose among three puzzle modes for each image.

pages.title: Unblocked
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Slide the other blocks aside to make an exit for the red one in Unblocked. Try to solve each of the 24 layouts in fewer moves, with hints available when needed.

pages.title: Extreme Hand Slap
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Choose a hand model and challenge a friend in Extreme Hand Slap. React quickly when it's your turn to dodge, and watch for the right moment to slap when you're on offense.

pages.title: Animal Tower
pages.creator: mixon.games
pages.description: Drop animals onto one another to build a tower in Animal Tower. Time each placement to keep the stack stable and collect coins and diamonds to unlock more animals.

pages.title: Vegetables Match 3
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Swap pieces to make rows or columns of three matching tiles in Vegetables Match 3. Clear the required tiles across 36 levels and use power-ups where they can open up the board.

pages.title: GUN NIGHT.IO
pages.creator: TD2TL
pages.description: Enter the arena in GUN NIGHT.IO, where a single bullet can take a player out. Respawn quickly, collect ammo around the map and use cover to line up your next shot.

pages.title: Christmas Challenge
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Throw snowballs at moving gifts in Christmas Challenge to break the ice around them. Lead your shots so Santa can collect the presents for the children.

pages.title: Pirate Bomber: Jewel Hunter
pages.creator: PowerSlash Studios
pages.description: Move the pirate to catch falling jewels in Pirate Bomber: Jewel Hunter. Dodge bombs and grab power-ups as items start to fall faster and in greater numbers.

pages.title: Christmas Snowman Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together six snowman pictures in Christmas Snowman Puzzle. Try a 16-piece board for a quick game or choose a larger piece count to spend more time on each scene.

pages.title: GunSpin
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Use recoil to propel a gun across the course in GunSpin. Time each shot to keep it moving before the ammo runs out, then buy upgrades with the coins you earn.

pages.title: Halloween Hidden Pumpkins
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Search spooky pictures for ten hidden pumpkins per level in Halloween Hidden Pumpkins. Watch the clock and scan the scene carefully to get through all six rounds.

pages.title: Halloween Shooter 3D
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Aim at pumpkins, bats and moths in Halloween Shooter 3D. Keep track of your bullets and wait for a clear shot so you can hit more targets before the ammunition runs out.

pages.title: Peugeot e208 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of the Peugeot e-208 in Peugeot e208 Puzzle. Pick one of six images and set the board to 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces.

pages.title: Math vs Bat
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Solve arithmetic problems to fire your cannon in Math vs Bat. Try addition, subtraction, multiplication or division and answer quickly enough to stop the bats from reaching your tower.

pages.title: SnakeVsNumbers
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Steer through numbered blocks in SnakeVsNumbers. Break through blocks with lower values to grow and think twice before choosing a path through a block that outmatches your snake.

pages.title: Tap Tap Dash
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide a running character along the narrow route in Tap Tap Dash. Tap at the marked turns and jumps, and time your moves so the character stays on the path.

pages.title: Airplane Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Flip cards and match the airplane pictures in Airplane Memory. Remember the location of each aircraft as you reveal the tiles, then try to finish with fewer guesses.

pages.title: Space Jump
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Time jumps between planets in Space Jump. Choose a character and try the different ways to play, using the position of the next planet to judge when to leap.

pages.title: Battle SWAT VS Mercenary
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Pick a side in Battle SWAT VS Mercenary and enter the map as a first-person shooter. Move with your team and use the terrain to get a better angle on opponents.

pages.title: Yuki and Rina Football
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Run drills with young footballers Yuki and Rina in Yuki and Rina Football. Build their skills through the training challenges as they work toward a place in the major league.

pages.title: Frosty Foxy
pages.creator: Game-Game.com.ua
pages.description: Jump and move across the snow in Frosty Foxy to gather crystals. Collect enough as the fox to bring more of its family into the game.

pages.title: Santa Snakes
pages.creator: webofgrafix
pages.description: Choose a festive snake skin in Santa Snakes and compete for room to grow. Watch the routes of the other snakes and turn away before you run into one.

pages.title: Falling Bottle Challenge
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Release a rotating bottle at the right moment in Falling Bottle Challenge. Try to send it through the gap without clipping the sides and keep going for a higher score.

pages.title: President Party
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Push the other leaders out of the ring in President Party, where an international summit turns into a sumo-style contest. Watch your position as the presidents and a pink rabbit collide.

pages.title: Jumping Jelly
pages.creator: c2gamesstudio
pages.description: Jump a jelly character upward in Jumping Jelly. Watch the route overhead and time the next jump to avoid obstacles as you try to climb into the clouds.

pages.title: Rise Up Balloon
pages.creator: MokoGames
pages.description: Move a shield above a rising balloon in Rise Up Balloon. Sweep falling obstacles out of its way and keep protecting it as it floats farther up the screen.

pages.title: Pizza Spot the Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare the pizza pictures in Pizza Spot the Difference and select each detail that changes. There is no countdown, so you can take your time looking at the toppings and background.

pages.title: Princess Mermaid Beauty Salon
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Give a mermaid a makeover in Princess Mermaid Beauty Salon. Try makeup options at the underwater salon and choose a matching look for her to wear afterward.

pages.title: Bonnie Kidney Transplant
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Guide a simulated kidney transplant in Bonnie Kidney Transplant. Follow the prompts as Ellie donates a kidney to Barbie and work through the steps of their hospital visit.

pages.title: Top Model Sisters
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Help Elsa and Anna prepare for their modeling careers in Top Model Sisters. Choose runway outfits for both sisters and style them for appearances in major fashion cities.

pages.title: Sheep Farm
pages.creator: Csharks Games & Solutions Pvt Ltd.
pages.description: Help Ben take care of the sheep and equipment in Sheep Farm. Make trips to the market to buy supplies and sell what the farm produces as you handle the day's work.

pages.title: Piano Time HTML5
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Decorate an instrument and the space around it in Piano Time HTML5. Then play the piano keys in any order you like to make up your own tune.

pages.title: A Maze Race
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Race a computer-controlled ball to the flag in A Maze Race. Read the corridors quickly and steer the green ball along a short route before the red one arrives.

pages.title: starblast.io
pages.creator: Neuronality
pages.description: Mine gems with a small spaceship in starblast.io and use them to improve its stats. Build up to stronger ships while watching for other pilots who might attack.

pages.title: Parking Fury 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Follow the markings through the lot in Parking Fury 1 and steer each car into place. Take the corners slowly enough to avoid bumping other vehicles or obstacles.

pages.title: Ship The Sheep
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: Pilot a UFO over Wild West farms in Ship The Sheep. Pick up sheep from the ground and fly them back to your space platform to finish the mission.

pages.title: Princess Kendama Design
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create a custom kendama in Princess Kendama Design. Pick how the toy looks and help the princess prepare her personalized design for her first kendama competition.

pages.title: Escape Fast
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Make a getaway after a double-cross in Escape Fast. Drive through traffic and narrow stretches, pick up coins along the way, and keep ahead of the police chasing you.

pages.title: Thrill Rush 4
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Ride a roller coaster through sudden gaps and obstacles in Thrill Rush 4. React in time to keep going through the daytime and nighttime tracks as the next hazard comes into view.

pages.title: Summer High Tea
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Dress for an afternoon tea in Summer High Tea. Customize a summer outfit, choose food and drinks to suit the occasion, and get your look ready for the camera.

pages.title: Modern Girls Dress Design!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design spring outfits for Princess Rachel in Modern Girls Dress Design! Help her put together clothes for the warmer weather before she goes out with her friends.
